definition: Catalysis of the reaction: (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-eicosatetraenoate + O2 + reduced [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase] = 20-hydroxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-eicosatetraenoate + H+ + H2O + oxidized [NADPH--hemoprotein reductase]. (5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-icosatetraenoic acid is also known as arachidonic acid is also and 20-hydroxy-(5Z,8Z,11Z,14Z)-eicosatetraenoate as 20-HETE.
label: arachidonate omega-hydroxylase activity
